features: ULTRA THIN UNDER PILLOW DESIGN Designed for comfortable nighttime use, this wireless pillow speaker fits discreetly beneath your pillow, allowing you to enjoy soothing music, meditation tracks, sleep sounds, audiobooks, podcasts, and relaxation audio without disturbing others around you.

BLUETOOTH WIRELESS CONNECTIVITY Connect seamlessly with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices. Stream your favorite sleep playlists, calming nature sounds, white noise tracks, guided meditation sessions, and bedtime audio with stable wireless performance.

PERFECT FOR SIDE SLEEPERS Slim and lightweight construction makes this mini speaker suitable for side sleepers. The compact profile sits comfortably under the pillow while delivering clear audio, helping create a peaceful sleeping environment for everyday relaxation.

WHITE NOISE & RELAXATION AUDIO SUPPORT Enjoy soothing sounds such as rain, ocean waves, nature ambience, meditation music, sleep stories, and white noise. Ideal for improving bedtime routines, creating a calm atmosphere, and supporting relaxation after a long day.

PORTABLE TRAVEL FRIENDLY DESIGN Compact size makes it easy to carry while travelling, camping, staying in hotels, or using at home. The rechargeable design eliminates the need for constant battery replacement and offers convenient daily use wherever you go.

PERSONAL LISTENING EXPERIENCE Provides private listening directly through your pillow without requiring bulky headphones. Suitable for bedtime music, podcasts, audiobooks, mindfulness sessions, and relaxing soundscapes while resting comfortably in bed.

EASY OPERATION & RECHARGEABLE BATTERY Simple control buttons allow convenient playback, volume adjustment, and Bluetooth pairing. Recharge using the included USB cable and enjoy wireless entertainment, relaxation audio, and sleep sounds throughout your daily routine.

VERSATILE HOME & BEDROOM COMPANION Suitable for bedrooms, guest rooms, dormitories, travel stays, meditation spaces, and relaxation corners. A practical audio device for listening to music, sleep sounds, guided breathing exercises, and calming nighttime content.
